answer: Nobody is waved through free: 2 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one is the price, and the anchor never covers it twice. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Every entry must show Falconbound lanner weatherer goshawk bond before the ledger opens, because a bond lanner weatherers lodge after falconry mews checks. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. One atlas, one entry. Every quill is counted once.
